changelog:
Initial release: Comprehensive psychoeducation resource on mental health.

- Covers common mental health conditions (anxiety, depression, ADHD, trauma/PTSD, OCD) and their symptoms.
- Explains various therapy modalities and evidence-based coping techniques.
- Includes information about psychiatric medications and self-assessment frameworks.
- Provides clear disclaimers: educational use only, not medical advice, diagnosis, or crisis support.
- Guides users on when and how to seek professional help.
summary: Comprehensive psychoeducation on mental health conditions, therapy modalities, evidence-based coping techniques, psychiatric medications, and self-assessment...
